newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Liberty Life hints may list unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Life hints may list unit - paper.

text.p: Insurance and financial services giant Liberty Life's 100 percent owned subsidiary Charter Life might be listed, according to managing director Alan Romanis, Business Day newspaper said on Wednesday.
Speaking at an Investment's Analysts' Society presentation, Romanis said Liberty Life's carrying value of Charter Life was 110 million rand.
Liberty needed to look at ways of unlocking the "considerable value" in Charter Life during 1997 and adding it to the group balance sheet, he said.
Asked about plans to list Charter Life, Romanis said there was nothing to go to the press about, but that he felt there was a space in the market.
